pages.title: La fissure
pages.text: $(o)The fifth theorem is the escape. The crack in the wall of the world.$()$(br2)Voss found it by exposing ordinary mycelium to an intense neutron flux. The mycelium $(l)changes$(). Becomes sensitive. Becomes $(#248)mycelium_active$().$(br2)It can then be ground into $(l)spores_active$(), the Soxhlet's input for Manifoldine.

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: Procedure:$(br)$(li)Build the $(l)Gamma Forge$() (3x3x3, line L5)$(li)Feed $(l)tritium$() from the Tritium Breeder$(li)Load 8 ordinary mycelium blocks$(li)8000 RF/t for 1200 ticks$(br2)Output: 8x $(#248)mycelium_active$(). Then grind it in the $(l)Mekanism Crusher$() for 8x $(l)spores_active$() per block.
$(o)The nuclear line is not decorative: no tritium, no mycelium, no Manifoldine.
